'''Kalya Zal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Zakuul}}</ref> [[Zakuul]] who lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Eternal Empire]]. The daughter of two [[Knights of Zakuul]], Kalya was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] like her [[Indo Zal's mother|mother]] and [[Indo Zal's father|father]], and she joined the [[Force vision/Legends|prophetic]] [[Scions of Zakuul]]. When her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Battle of Scyva]]<ref name="Codex" /> decades before [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Scyva-Time">{{TOR_updates|5.0}} The Codex entry for [[Indo Zal]], who is a grown adult during the events of ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'', states that the [[Battle of Scyva]] occurred when Zal was six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, and Zal is middle-aged during the events of ''Eternal Throne''; thus, the battle must occur well before the events of ''Eternal Throne'' in 3630 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Kalya was left to raise her six-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old brother [[Indo Zal|Indo]] herself.<ref name="Codex" />

Although Indo was not a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-user himself, Kalya taught him how to influence people, fit in with the [[Zakuulan]] elite, and rise in the social structure of the Eternal Empire, leading him to become a famous entertainer and fixer. However,<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] ordered his sister,<ref name="Scion">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Scions of Zakuul}}</ref> [[High Justice]] [[Vaylin]], to execute the Scions, and Kalya Zal was among the casualties. Indo was devastated by her death and, in an effort to avenge Kalya, worked his way into Vaylin's service so that he could get close to her and eventually [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin|bring her down]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalya Zal was mentioned in the Codex entry for Indo Zal in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']],<ref name="Codex" /> the [[2016]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Launch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161202-1|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Now Live!}}</ref>
